snippet.title: A Lateral Thinking Puzzle Game - Now on Steam!
snippet.description:
Mind Gazing is a lateral-thinking social puzzle game where every strange story hides a single truth.

🤖 Play solo with AI
👥 Challenge other players in multiplayer
👽 Share your custom stories with the community
🔍 Ask questions, uncover clues, and solve the mystery.

🧩 Now available on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4708770/Mind_Gazing/
